component.name: Siphon
component.summary: Download manager for file hosts and direct links

description.p: A downloader for mega.nz, gofile, mediafire, pixeldrain, bunkr, cyberdrop, cyberfile and direct links, with a persistent queue: pause, resume, several downloads at once, and a command line tool for scripts.

mega downloads over 8 connections, and when the transfer quota runs out they resume by themselves after a VPN switch. With yt-dlp or gallery-dl installed, Siphon also queues video and gallery pages from thousands more sites.
